rationale: The replication successfully reproduces the core symmetry-defined theory claim: deterministic field-free SOT switching occurs only when σz is present (J‖T), with polarity set by current sign, and vanishes when σz is absent (J⊥T). This matches the paper's key control experiment. However, the paper is predominantly experimental (epitaxial growth, XRD, SQUID, AHE, ST-FMR, MOKE imaging), and these measurements are intrinsically non-reproducible computationally. The absolute critical current density, partial domain switching, and microscopic σz derivation were not quantitatively verified. Coverage is limited because only the mechanistic switching claim was tested, not the bulk experimental characterization.
